evidence.r1: Only the nav pill, day-selector pill and Tickets button floating over the street photo are glass; the Programme, Strands and Passes sections below are opaque content, shot-fv-light/dark and shot-full-light.
evidence.r2: The nav pill, day-selector and Tickets button occupy separate non-overlapping positions across the top bar, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r3: Three glass elements in the header (nav, day picker, tickets), each load-bearing, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r4: All three header elements show the same frosted regular-glass look over the street photo in both schemes.
evidence.r5: No clear-variant glass appears; the Tickets popover (shot-menu-light) matches the same frosted treatment as the bar.
evidence.r6: Only the red Tickets button carries a saturated tint in shot-fv-light/dark; the nav pill and day-selector stay neutral, matching the primary 'buy tickets' action.
evidence.r7: The nav pill and day-selector show blur and highlight edges over the snowy street rather than a flat fill, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r8: The nav pill, day pills and Tickets button are all capsules; the Tickets popover is a fixed-radius rounded rectangle, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r9: The 'Single ticket' row highlighted in the Tickets popover sits inset from the popover's own corner radius without pinching, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r10: The day-selector pills and Tickets button are capsules; the popover's ticket-type rows are small, dense rounded rectangles, shot-menu-light.
evidence.r11: The nav links, day selector and Tickets button form three separate glass groups across the header, at the three-group limit, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r12: The nav pill holds text links only; the day selector holds text-only date pills; Tickets pairs one label with its own chevron, so no pill mixes a separate text button with a separate icon button, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r13: Glass is applied to each pill's outer capsule; labels and dates sit on one shared surface rather than being individually glassed, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r14: The nav pill, day selector and Tickets button keep visible gaps between them across the header, shot-fv-light.
evidence.r15: In tile-2-light/dark the 'Programme' heading is only partly visible, ghosted through the nav pill's blur rather than faded by a gradient mask as it passes underneath; the page scrolls but shows no built edge effect.
evidence.r16: The header pills sit over the varied snowy street photo, never a flat field, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r17: In tile-2-light/dark the top of the 'Programme' heading sits directly under the floating nav pill at a settled scroll position, visible only faded through the glass rather than cleared of it.
evidence.r18: Nav text (black in light, white in dark) and the white Tickets label both read clearly against their pills over the photo, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r19: shot-reduced only shows the transparency switch turning the header pills more opaque; no increased-contrast or reduced-motion state is captured.
evidence.r20: The street photo and every section below (Programme, Strands, Passes, Visit) span the full 1440px width in shot-full-light/dark, with only the header pills floating over the hero portion.
evidence.r21: The 'Programme' heading in tile-2-light/dark scrolls up without enough safe-area clearance and sits partly under the nav pill instead of being fully cleared before reaching it.
evidence.r22: The Tickets popover (shot-menu-light/dark) adds no dark scrim behind it beyond its own glass edge.
evidence.r23: Only the Tickets popover's position directly below the Tickets button (shot-menu-light) can be checked from stills, not morph or press feedback.
evidence.r24: Nav and day-selector text are monochrome black/white; the single red Tickets fill is the sanctioned one-control tint, matching r6, shot-fv-light/dark.
evidence.r25: Black nav text in light mode and white nav text in dark mode both stay distinct from the grey/white snowy street behind them.
